blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – United States President Donald Trump arrived in the Philippines on Tuesday, November 17, for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, marking his participation in the regional gathering of Southeast Asian leaders. The Air Force One aircraft transporting Trump landed at the Balagbag Ramp Area (Ages Ramp) at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) in Pasay City at exactly 5:33 p.m. He was welcombed by Executive Secretary Ralph Recto, House Majority Leader and presidential son, Sandro Marcos, US Ambassador to the Philippines Lee Lipton, together with Philippine Ambassador to the US Jose Manuel “Babe” Romualdez.
